name: trap
description: Run a command when the shell receives a signal

choices.name: HUP
choices.description: Hangup detected on the controlling terminal

choices.name: QUIT
choices.description: Quit from the keyboard, with a core dump

choices.name: TERM
choices.description: Request to terminate (the default kill signal)

choices.name: STOP
choices.description: Pause the process; cannot be caught
